en: A black‑and‑white historical postcard view of a European city boulevard with tram tracks and several pedestrians. On the right stands a large, ornate neoclassical building with a central dome and mansard roofs, facing a landscaped triangular park with paths, trees, and low hedges. In the distance are more multi‑story buildings and church spires under a hazy sky. The image appears slightly faded and worn, typical of early‑20th‑century postcards. No clear caption or title is visible on the front.
